thread:
Sam Patel: Quick sync — we need to lock prioritization for the "Serving Insights" roadmap (batching recommendations, prefix caching, quantization suggestions, eval-triggered alerts). Looking for consensus on M0 vs M1 scope and launch criteria. :eyes:
Priya Nair: +1. From infra: batching + prefix caching are high ROI for customers with short-turn queries. Quant recs are riskier (need eval ops and benching).
Matt Cho: For quant recs we should surface safe defaults + clear warnings. Propose we ship a 'suggested profile' (read-only) rather than auto-applying changes initially.
Anya Rivera: Customer asks — Acme & Nimbus asked for a simple Console toggle and a webhook for quality regressions. Enterprise buyers want deterministic rollback and audit logs.
Sam Patel: Proposed M0 (launchable):
- UI: recommendations panel in Console with short explainers + CTAs
- API: read-only endpoint `/v1/insights/recommendations` and job status for evals
- Serving: batching hints + a prefix-cache on/off control surfaced
- Alerts: eval-triggered webhook + daily digest email
SLO guardrails: p95 inference latency impact <5%, recommendation churn rate <10% on canary prompts, and no >5% regression on our core eval set.
Priya Nair: M1 (stretch):
- auto-applied batch profiles behind a feature flag
- quant suggestion templates per model family (Llama2, Mistral-like, etc.)
- per-customer custom evals and retention of past eval runs for trend analysis
Matt Cho: Implementation notes / concerns:
```
// prototype: launch a lightweight eval job
POST /v1/insights/eval
{
  "prompt_set": "smoke_candidates",
  "metrics": ["accuracy","latency","safety_score"]
}
```
We need a standard metric set and a way to tag baseline runs. Also guardrails for hallucination-sensitive prompts.
Sam Patel: Launch criteria checklist (must haves):
- end-to-end UX flows + docs + examples
- 2 pilot customers onboarded (1 PLG, 1 enterprise)
- e2e tests and perf regressions blocked by CI
- rollback plan + telemetry (model variant fallback + feature-flag switch)
Anya Rivera: Product ask: please include a customer-facing changelog, an obvious Console opt-out, and a webhook payload schema for CS to integrate.
Priya Nair: Triage / priority: batching + cache controls = P0; basic eval-triggered alerts = P0; quantization recommendations (read-only) = P1; auto-apply quant or batch profiles = P2.
Matt Cho: Agree with priorities. For quant recs we should require an offline sim (eval run) before surfacing to customers. That reduces risk and support load.
Sam Patel: Timeline proposal: 8 weeks for M0 if we commit a 3-4 person cross-functional squad. I'll draft a PRD this afternoon and assign owners.
Anya Rivera: CS fine with that cadence. We should line up the pilot customers this week. I'll ping Acme + Nimbus.
Priya Nair: Infra: need a capacity estimate for the eval jobs and a simple storage plan for eval artifacts. I'll put up a spec.
Matt Cho: I'll sketch the model-level templates and a minimal library to run quick quant sims.
deploy-bot: Scheduled 30m sync for 1768200000 — invites sent to participants.
Sam Patel: Thanks all — I'll file the PRD + ticket list and share before the sync. Closing thread.
